newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT - Bufete debt recommended.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Bufete debt recommended.

text.p: Mexican construction company Bufete's 11.375 percent Eurobond due 7/15/99 is a good short-term bet, Bear Stearns said on Thursday.

- "Despite the 43 basis points spread tightening since our initial recommendation, we contine to recommend purchase of the Bufete 11.375 perent eurobonds due 7/15/99 for investors seeking attractive returns in the short term sector," analyst Mark S. Agnew wrote.
- Bufete's notes have the highest spread of the short term Mexican eurobonds, he said.
- "Additionally, if Bufete collects an overdue 500 million pesos receivable payment from CFE (federal electricity commission) as expected, the company will retire debt," he wrote.
